_doc: Size guards for the built game.js and html (ported from the legacy release gate). Each section is measured in UTF-8 bytes from the first 'from' match up to the first 'to' match. mode 'optional': a missing section measures 0. mode 'required': a missing or misplaced section fails. 'lastIndexOf' (PART 57 only) also requires that marker between from and to, exactly as the legacy gate did. Read by scripts/build.mjs, tests/repo/r_build.js and the gate.
